purpose: Task-stratified descriptive diagnostic of archived B reference-contract rejections, not a replacement benchmark or new model inference.

sampling.algorithm: minimum SHA256 of contract_relaxation_v1|seed|model|task|case_id within each nonempty stratum
sampling.population_scope: Structural contract rejections only, not schema failures or all 2133 outputs; previous seven scene IDs excluded across models.
sampling.empty_strata: Reported as no eligible output; never filled with another task or known example.

validation: Bypass only exact reference phase count/skill sequence; retain original schema/affordance/target checks. No skill/order/target edits, no GT repairs or new geometric parameters. Ambiguous phase-dependent semantics and undefined native templates are unsupported, not physical failures.

endpoints.native_goal: All original calls appear unchanged in trace, no stage exception, goal true; no-action control goal false.
endpoints.all_stage_goal: native_goal plus every per-step stage_success is true.
endpoints.partial_stage_goal: native_goal but at least one stage_success is false.
endpoints.control_failure: Reported; alternative goal failure is not attributed purely to planning when the matched reference also fails.

inference_policy: No new model calls; no changes to original B outputs or scores. Diagnostic selection made after prior exploratory results, not preregistered.
reporting: Task/model coverage, fixed sample and runnable denominators, support/validation rejection, goal and stage outcomes, native exceptions/timeouts, and matched controls separately. No population false-rejection estimate or causal planning-ability claim from this small sample.
